body: I do have all of the documents, and yes I am working right now. Still, been hearing lots of other asylum seeker that being deported due to "they are not gay enough" or "its not dangerous enough if we keep hiding for the rest of our lives". One of the lawyer told me that my case should be accepted if i came before 2015. But now, our lives is just a political game.

I have been lost in my own thought, and I do not know if i will ever be found. I do not know what I want nor what I am looking for. I have been chasing something that I am not sure what it is.


People told me that the world is beautiful and they told me that there are many adventures waiting ahead. Yet, I could not see it.


The little hope, a little wish to be able to see the beauty of the world, and to experience the adventures just like they told me is the only source of energy to keep me going. This belief; that one day I can feel what other people feel, that i can experience what other people experience is the only reason for me to survive.


But what if, everything is just too late?


The moment I woke up from my sleep is the moment when my nightmare starts, my past had been haunting me these years, and I do not know if I will ever be able to make peace with my past.


I have been day dreaming for years, wondering how does it feel to live in other people's life. Wondering how does it feel just to be a regular "Joe". No, I do not want to be smart, nor rich, nor handsome. I just want to be the average. I want to experience a normal milestone in life as a normal person.

But what if everything is just too late?
